note: A 2026 J. Alloys Compd. paper on pressure-induced transitions and superconductivity of actinium exists, but its abstract is not available to me, so I could not tell whether it reports measurements; searches 'AcYbTl2 ... synthesis crystal structure' and 'actinium superconductivity' were run.
Searched 'AcYbTl2 ... synthesis crystal structure' and 'actinium superconductivity'; no report of this ternary turned up, only actinium theory and hydride papers.
Searched 'CaYbPb2 ... intermetallic synthesis' and 'Yb Ca Pb ternary superconductivity'; only a Materials Project data record (calculated Heusler structure) appeared, with no synthesis report.

Czybulka et al. (1992, DOI verified) report CsM2X2 arsenides with M = Ir in the ThCr2Si2-type structure (space group 139, matching the database entry), but no low-temperature measurement was found; searches 'CsIr2As2 ... synthesis crystal structure' and 'iridium arsenide superconductivity' gave nothing further.

Czybulka et al. (1992, DOI verified) list CsCo2As2 among new CsM2X2 arsenides in the ThCr2Si2-type structure, but no low-temperature data was found; searches 'CsCo2As2 ... synthesis ThCr2Si2' and 'CsCo2As2 superconductivity' returned only related arsenide papers.

Searched 'InBi ... compound synthesis crystal structure' and 'indium bismuth alloy superconductivity'; Rehaag et al. (2025, DOI verified) grew InBi single crystals but the abstract gives no structure type to compare with the database's SG 216 entry, and the superconductivity found (Gandhi and Wu 2017, DOI verified, Tc 5.86 K) is in Bi-In composites where the superconducting phase is In2Bi, not InBi.
Searched 'La3Pb ... synthesis crystal structure' and 'La3Pb superconductivity'; the La-Pb phases reported were La5Pb3, La4Pb3 and others, with no La3Pb.

No report of NaYbPb2 was found; the hits were unrelated sodium ytterbium phosphates and a Yb-Li gas study; searches: 'NaYbPb2 synthesis crystal structure' and 'ytterbium sodium lead superconductivity'.

Bortolozo et al. (2017) report superconducting evidence in a processed Nb2GeC compound; I verified the DOI and title but could not retrieve the abstract, so Tc is not recorded and the verdict rests on the title; searches: 'Nb2GeC MAX phase synthesis crystal structure' and 'Nb2GeC superconductivity'.

Korol'kov et al. (2010, DOI verified) report Ru-Os solid solutions from thermolysis consistent with the Ru-Os phase diagram, so the 1:1 alloy is known as a disordered solid solution; no report of its superconductivity was found in searches 'osmium ruthenium alloy superconductivity hcp solid solution' and 'Os-Ru alloy synthesis crystal structure'.
Searched 'Re3Ir ... intermetallic synthesis crystal structure' and 'rhenium iridium alloy superconductivity'; no Re3Ir report appeared, only rare-earth iridides and Re or Ir boride papers.

Chu, Smith and Gardner (1968) report superconductivity of rhenium and Re-Os alloys at high pressure, but the abstract does not confirm the solid-solution description of the 1:1 composition or an ambient-pressure Tc; searches: 'ReOs alloy synthesis crystal structure' and 'rhenium osmium alloy superconductivity'.

The same verified Chu et al. (1968) paper concerns Re-Os alloys with superconductivity under pressure, but the Os3Re composition and its structure are not confirmed from the abstract; searches were run on the Re-Os element pair: 'ReOs alloy synthesis crystal structure' and 'rhenium osmium alloy superconductivity'.

Compton et al. (1961) on technetium alloys notes that Tc and Re form alloys similarly, but no verified source reports a Re-Tc 1:1 solid solution or its superconductivity; searches: 'rhenium technetium alloy synthesis superconductivity' and 'technetium superconductivity'.

No verified source describing a Ru3Rh or Ru-Rh alloy phase or its superconductivity was found, only Ru-Rh carbonyl clusters and unrelated papers; searches: 'Ru3Rh synthesis crystal structure', 'Ru-Rh alloy superconductivity' and 'ruthenium rhodium hcp solid solution phase diagram'.

No report of SbTe2 was found; the Sb-Te hits were Sb2Te3 (a different stoichiometry) and its superconductivity under pressure; searches: 'SbTe2 synthesis crystal structure antimony telluride phase' and 'antimony telluride superconductivity pressure'.

Niewa et al. (2004) synthesized ScTaN2 (P6_3/mmc) and report magnetization and resistivity data showing a diamagnetic small-gap semiconductor or semimetal with no superconductivity, but the temperature range is not stated in the abstract I could read; searches: 'ScTaN2 scandium tantalum nitride synthesis' and 'scandium tantalum nitride superconductivity'.

Liu and Corbett (2003) synthesized and structurally characterized SrPtTl2 in Cmcm, but their property measurements are reported only for the Pd analogue (metallic) and no low-temperature data for SrPtTl2 was found; searches: 'SrPt2Tl2 OR SrTl2Pt synthesis crystal structure' and 'strontium platinum thallium superconductivity'.

Searched 'Tc3Ru ... alloy synthesis crystal structure' and 'technetium ruthenium superconductivity'; found Tc-solute superconductivity work (Koch et al. 1974) but no report of Tc3Ru itself, so the phase and its superconductivity could not be confirmed.

The verified review reports that the orthorhombic O-phase Ti2AlNb is produced in Ti-Al-Nb alloys by additive manufacturing, but I found no low-temperature or superconductivity measurement; searches: 'Ti2AlNb orthorhombic O-phase synthesis crystal structure' and 'Ti2AlNb superconductivity'.

No verified source describing an Ag-Pt 1:1 alloy phase or its superconductivity was found, and the only Ag-Pt hit was an undated nanoparticle thesis without a DOI; searches: 'Ag-Pt alloy synthesis crystal structure superconductivity' and 'silver platinum solid solution phase diagram'.

Kim and Fassler (2008, DOI verified) give the P-3m1 crystal structure of BaSn2 from a fusion synthesis, and a 2017 PRB study of BaSn2 covered its topology with no superconductivity report; searches 'BaSn2 ... synthesis crystal structure' and 'barium stannide superconductivity' found nothing further.

No report of Ir2BeSi (BeSiIr2) was found; the keyword search returned nothing and the semantic fallback returned unrelated beryllium silicate and nitride papers; searches: 'Ir2BeSi synthesis crystal structure' and 'iridium beryllium silicide superconductivity'.

Searched 'CaPmZn2 ... synthesis crystal structure' and 'promethium intermetallic superconductivity'; the only match is a Materials Project data record (calculated Heusler structure), with no synthesis report found.
No report of CoTc3 was found; the Tc hits were technetium carbonyl complexes and a Co-Ta phase paper; searches: 'CoTc3 cobalt technetium intermetallic' and 'cobalt technetium superconductivity'.

No verified source describing a Dy-Ho alloy or its superconductivity was found, so no verdict can be supported; searches: 'Dy-Ho dysprosium holmium alloy superconductivity' and 'dysprosium holmium solid solution hexagonal close-packed lattice parameters'.

No report of EuAg2Ge2 was found; the hits were EuAgGe, Eu2AgGe3 and EuCu2Ge2, which are different compositions; searches: 'EuAg2Ge2 synthesis crystal structure' and 'europium silver germanide superconductivity'.
Searched 'Hf2CS ... synthesis crystal structure' and 'hafnium carbon sulfur superconductivity'; found Hf2S, HfOS and Hf2FeC2S reports but no Hf2CS.

No report of KRu2P2 synthesis was found; the only related hits were a CaKRu4P4 (1144-type) paper and a computational phosphide study; searches: 'KRu2P2 synthesis crystal structure' and 'KRu2P2 superconductivity ruthenium phosphide'.

No experimental report of LiGdHg2 was found; the only entries were Materials Project computed records for LiDyHg2 and LiHoHg2; searches: 'LiGdHg2 synthesis crystal structure' and 'gadolinium lithium mercury superconductivity'.

Zhang et al. (2026, DOI verified) describe alpha-MnTe as nickeline (NiAs-type) with antiferromagnetic order and no superconductivity, the zinc-blende form (SG 216) appears only as a metastable MBE film (arXiv 2404.08897), and SnTe-MnTe solid solutions superconduct at a different composition (Mathur et al. 1973, DOI verified); searches 'MnTe zinc blende thin film NiAs structure synthesis' and 'MnTe superconductivity' were run.

No report of NdAl2Ni was found; the hits were other Al-Ni or Nd-containing phases such as La2NiAl7 and Nd2Ni7; searches: 'NdAl2Ni synthesis crystal structure' and 'neodymium aluminium nickel superconductivity'.

No Pa-Ge intermetallic was found; the protactinium hits were Pa metal, Pa arsenides and Pa hydride calculations; searches: 'Pa3Ge protactinium germanium intermetallic synthesis' and 'protactinium compound superconductivity'.

Haire (1988, DOI verified as registered) reports a structural study of promethium metal under pressure, and no low-temperature measurement was found; searches 'promethium metal preparation crystal structure' and 'Pm element superconductivity low temperature' were run.
Searched 'Sm3Hg ... crystal structure synthesis' and 'samarium mercury amalgam superconductivity'; only other mercury amalgams and unrelated papers came up.
Searched 'Tb2CBr ... synthesis' and 'terbium carbide halide superconductivity'; found reduced terbium bromides (Tb6Br7, Tb16Br23B4) and terbium-carbide fullerene papers, but no Tb2CBr.
No experimental report of Tc3Pd was found; the only record was a Materials Project computed entry; searches: 'Tc3Pd technetium palladium compound' and 'palladium technetium superconductivity alloys'.
Searched 'ThNiSi2 ... crystal structure synthesis' and 'thorium nickel silicide superconductivity'; the hits were ThSi2, ThM2Si2 and ThNiSi-type papers, not ThNiSi2.

Searched 'yttrium holmium alloy solid solution crystal structure superconductivity' and 'Y-Ho hcp rare earth alloy heavy superconductivity'; the results were unrelated, and the one candidate source (Gschneidner and Calderwood 1982, binary rare-earth phase diagrams, DOI 10.1007/bf02876155) is a compilation I did not read.

Searched 'ZrCd3 ... intermetallic synthesis crystal structure' and 'zirconium cadmium superconductivity Laves'; a 1969 Cd-Zr intermetallic structure paper came up but its abstract is not available to me, so ZrCd3 can be neither confirmed nor excluded.
